source.file: Wolfe et al. /Wolfe et al experimental data.csv

primary_endpoint: Day-21 joint metacommunity presence of generalist Stentor coeruleus and specialist Didinium nasutum or Dileptus anser

source_row_guard.reason: unconfirmed matrix_dispersal label conflicting with same experimental treatment code

exchangeability_assumption: Hypothetically exchange labels of the 4 heterogeneous and 4 homogeneous experimental units within each independent patch-count x matrix x corridor stratum under a sharp null; original random allocation protocol and complete outcome-independent missingness NOT verified.

null_definition.integer_test_statistic: sum_strata(2*X-K) for overall; six-patch sum minus four-patch sum for 6−4 contrast
null_definition.exact_computation: BigInt dynamic-programming convolution, no Monte Carlo error
null_definition.output: range of exact conditional tail probabilities over all 2^5 missing binary outcome assignments

execution_fix: exact script basename required to avoid running CLI during test module import
